description: This PHP test class 'AbstractLeaveAllocationServiceTest' contains unit tests for the abstract service 'AbstractLeaveAllocationService' related to leave allocations in the OrangeHRM project. It tests methods such as 'addHoursDuration' and 'getDurationInHours'.

classes.name: AbstractLeaveAllocationServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing methods in the AbstractLeaveAllocationService class, specifically testing leave duration calculations.

methods.name: testAddHoursDuration
methods.description: Tests the addHoursDuration method for correctness of time addition logic.

methods.name: testGetDurationInHours
methods.description: Tests the getDurationInHours method to verify correct computation of hours between two DateTime objects.
